title: Elections 2026
text:
This map shows the county-level 2026 U.S. Senate election. Blue counties favored the Democratic candidate, and red counties favored the Republican candidate. The color shows the margin between the Democratic and Republican vote totals.






Source: North Carolina State Board of Elections, 2026 November 3 general election results.
